golden_rules.query: Does anchor achieve correct preliminary setting attitude?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor rests on its side supported between skids, shank end, and chisel-tip
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection during deployment
golden_rules.failure_indication: Anchor not orienting correctly for setting

golden_rules.query: What is the initial setting distance?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor should set within one anchor length of landing point
golden_rules.test_method: Measure distance from initial touchdown to set position
golden_rules.failure_indication: Anchor dragging beyond one length before setting

golden_rules.query: Does anchor maintain set position under load changes?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor remains buried and maintains upright attitude
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor anchor position during tide/wind changes
golden_rules.failure_indication: Anchor rolling out or losing set position

golden_rules.query: Is roll-foil clear of fouling during setting?
golden_rules.expected_value: No mud/debris accumulation blocking roll-foil function
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection after retrieval
golden_rules.failure_indication: Clogged roll-foil affecting self-righting

golden_rules.query: Does Vulcan roll-palm support anchor on soft mud?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor supported when landing on-end in soft substrate
golden_rules.test_method: Deployment test in soft mud conditions
golden_rules.failure_indication: Anchor sinking vertically without self-righting

golden_rules.query: Is shackle properly sized for chain end-link?
golden_rules.expected_value: Largest possible shackle that fits chain end-link
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of shackle pin diameter vs chain end-link opening
golden_rules.failure_indication: Undersized shackle compromising system strength

golden_rules.query: Is shackle pin properly seized?
golden_rules.expected_value: Two turns of stainless steel or Monel seizing wire
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of seizing wire installation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Risk of shackle pin working loose

golden_rules.query: Is swivel rated appropriately?
golden_rules.expected_value: Rated to breaking strength of chain
golden_rules.test_method: Check swivel specifications against chain rating
golden_rules.failure_indication: Underrated swivel creating weak point

golden_rules.query: Is swivel connected directly to Vulcan shank?
golden_rules.expected_value: No direct connection - chain links required between swivel and anchor
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of connection method
golden_rules.failure_indication: Unsafe direct swivel connection

golden_rules.query: Does anchor self-launch from bow roller?
golden_rules.expected_value: Smooth self-launch when released
golden_rules.test_method: Test launch operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Launching difficulty indicates roller system issues

golden_rules.query: Does anchor recover onto roller in correct orientation?
golden_rules.expected_value: Smooth transition to roller in upright position
golden_rules.test_method: Observe recovery operation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Violent self-righting action risking boat damage

golden_rules.query: Is anchor properly secured for stowage?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor fits securely on bow with minimal movement when underway
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection and physical check of anchor mounting during vessel movement
golden_rules.failure_indication: Excessive movement or insecure fit when mounted on bow

golden_rules.query: Does anchor set properly in seabed?
golden_rules.expected_value: Quick setting with strong holding power across all seabed types
golden_rules.test_method: Field testing in various seabed conditions (weed, kelp, grass, etc)
golden_rules.failure_indication: Slow or unreliable setting, poor holding power

golden_rules.query: Are all attachment points intact?
golden_rules.expected_value: All points (shackle, rode, retrieval line, tandem) secure with no wear
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of all attachment points for wear or damage
golden_rules.failure_indication: Visible wear, deformation or damage to any attachment point

golden_rules.query: Is anchor maintaining integrity under load?
golden_rules.expected_value: No bending in shank or load-bearing components under normal use
golden_rules.test_method: Inspection of components after heavy loading conditions
golden_rules.failure_indication: Any visible bending or deformation in shank or components

golden_rules.query: Does anchor resist roll-out?
golden_rules.expected_value: Maintains embedding under heavy or veering loads
golden_rules.test_method: Field testing under various load conditions and directions
golden_rules.failure_indication: Anchor breaks free or rolls out under load changes

golden_rules.query: What is the minimum safe scope ratio for anchor deployment?
golden_rules.expected_value: 3:1 ratio of rode-length to water depth
golden_rules.test_method: Measure rode length and divide by vertical distance from seabed to bow roller
golden_rules.failure_indication: Insufficient holding power and risk of anchor dragging

golden_rules.query: What is the recommended normal scope ratio for anchoring?
golden_rules.expected_value: 5:1 ratio of rode-length to water depth
golden_rules.test_method: Measure rode length and divide by vertical distance from seabed to bow roller
golden_rules.failure_indication: Sub-optimal holding power

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum recommended scope ratio for bad weather?
golden_rules.expected_value: 8:1 ratio of rode-length to water depth
golden_rules.test_method: Measure rode length and divide by vertical distance from seabed to bow roller
golden_rules.failure_indication: No additional benefit beyond this ratio

golden_rules.query: Is anchor deployment over live coral permitted?
golden_rules.expected_value: No deployment on or near live coral
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of seafloor before deployment
golden_rules.failure_indication: Environmental damage risk

golden_rules.query: Is a chain-stop required for larger boats?
golden_rules.expected_value: Yes, recommended for stress reduction on windlass
golden_rules.test_method: Verify presence and proper installation of chain-stop
golden_rules.failure_indication: Excessive stress on windlass

golden_rules.query: Is a rope snubber required with all-chain rode?
golden_rules.expected_value: Yes, advisable for shock absorption
golden_rules.test_method: Verify presence and proper installation of rope snubber
golden_rules.failure_indication: Excessive peak loads and chain rumble

golden_rules.query: Is the retrieval line properly attached to Rocna Original/Mk II?
golden_rules.expected_value: Line attached by shackle to retrieval point, kept outside roll-bar/roll-foil
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of attachment point and line routing
golden_rules.failure_indication: Line routed incorrectly or wrong attachment method used

golden_rules.query: Is the retrieval line properly attached to Vulcan?
golden_rules.expected_value: Line fed through from top with secure figure-of-8 knot
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of knot and line routing
golden_rules.failure_indication: Missing/incorrect knot or improper line routing

golden_rules.query: Is tandem anchor chain properly attached?
golden_rules.expected_value: Chain attached to tandem point, rode over fluke and through roll-bar
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of chain routing and attachment
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incorrect routing may cause primary anchor pull-out

golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection and cleaning log

golden_rules.expected_value: Interior regularly rinsed with fresh water
golden_rules.test_method: Inspect roll-bar interior for debris/salt

golden_rules.expected_value: Dry storage with air circulation and drainage
golden_rules.test_method: Inspect storage area conditions

golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of coating

golden_rules.query: Is breather hole clear?
golden_rules.expected_value: Unobstructed hole on roll-bar
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of breather hole
golden_rules.failure_indication: Improper zinc drainage during galvanizing

golden_rules.query: Is stainless steel surface free of rust?
golden_rules.expected_value: No rust spots or contamination
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of surface

golden_rules.query: Is anchor free from organic materials?
golden_rules.expected_value: Clean surface without biofouling
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection for organic matter
golden_rules.failure_indication: Increased corrosion risk

golden_rules.query: Is surface finish smooth?
golden_rules.expected_value: No deep scratches or damage
golden_rules.test_method: Visual and tactile inspection
golden_rules.failure_indication: Need for re-passivation

golden_rules.query: Is warranty claim form submission valid?
golden_rules.expected_value: Form must be filled completely and submitted to support@rocna.com
golden_rules.test_method: Verify form submission receipt and completeness
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incomplete form or wrong submission method

golden_rules.query: Is anchor being used according to User's Guide?
golden_rules.expected_value: Usage must strictly follow User's Guide specifications
golden_rules.test_method: Compare actual usage to User's Guide requirements
golden_rules.failure_indication: Usage outside specified parameters voids warranty

golden_rules.query: Is product defect eligible for warranty?
golden_rules.expected_value: Faulty or damaged anchors qualify for replacement or refund
golden_rules.test_method: Inspect anchor for manufacturing defects or damage
golden_rules.failure_indication: Non-warranty damage or normal wear

golden_rules.query: Is shackle properly attached for foul ground operation?
golden_rules.expected_value: Shackle attached to shackle rail slot using stainless steel shackle
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of shackle placement
golden_rules.failure_indication: Improper attachment could lead to retrieval difficulties

golden_rules.query: Is anchor sized correctly for vessel?
golden_rules.expected_value: Anchor size matches official Rocna sizing chart recommendations
golden_rules.test_method: Compare boat specifications to Rocna sizing chart
golden_rules.failure_indication: Warranty void if undersized

golden_rules.query: For overnight anchoring, is secure point used?
golden_rules.expected_value: Shackle attached to secure point, not rail slot
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection of attachment point
golden_rules.failure_indication: Risk of unintentional un-setting during wind/tide changes

golden_rules.query: For anchors over 110kg, is sizing appropriate?
golden_rules.expected_value: Size matches classification society rules referenced by Rocna
golden_rules.test_method: Compare specifications to classification society requirements
golden_rules.failure_indication: Warranty coverage may be void

golden_rules.query: Has anchor been modified by unauthorized party?
golden_rules.expected_value: No unauthorized modifications present
golden_rules.test_method: Visual inspection for modifications
golden_rules.failure_indication: Warranty void if modified
